item.title: [−1] Foreign investors have pulled ₹48,056 crore from Indian equities in October; 2026 outflows near ₹3.10 trillion
item.description:
Financials and FMCG saw the largest outflows in early October. Foreign funds bought on Friday, but the month is on course for a record. Ongoing, slower pace.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — FMCG outflows

Why it matters: Sustained outflows weigh on bank and FMCG heavyweights and the rupee; the slower recent pace hints at stabilisation only if oil eases.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Mobile tariffs expected to rise about 15% in December as operators target higher revenue per user
item.description:
A further rise in household costs on top of high fuel and food inflation. New.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Less spare household spending

Why it matters: Higher phone bills add to retail inflation and squeeze household spending on other goods.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
